response.overview: Yangon, 2026. Beneath the rhythms of power cuts the city continues to survive, yet a quiet unease lingers in every breath it takes. On the eve of her ex-boyfriend's departure from Myanmar, a young aspiring filmmaker, wakes to an ordinary day that will end with a final goodbye. Today, she has got one final rendezvous with her ex-boyfriend who is leaving Myanmar tomorrow.
response.tagline: On the eve of her ex-boyfriend's departure from Myanmar, a young filmmaker spends one last afternoon with him in Yangon – a city that has witnessed and remembered love, loss, and the weight of a generation's choices.
response.title: Going Nowhere
